content: 1. The World Health Organization published a document in 2013 titled Contraceptive Eligibility for Women at High Risk of HIV. This guidance provides recommendations on contraceptive methods suitable for women at high risk of HIV. The document is accessible online at the WHO website, with the last access date being April 21, 2021. 2. Another WHO publication, Contraceptive Eligibility for Women at High Risk of HIV, offers detailed guidance on contraceptive methods for women at elevated risk of HIV. This document was accessed on May 10, 2021, and is available on the WHO reproductive health publications page. 3. Barden-O’Fallon and Reynolds conducted an assessment of family planning service delivery by evaluating selected indicators across implementing partners. Their findings are documented in a publication available on the specified website, last accessed on January 27, 2021. 4. The Family Planning 2020 Core Indicators document provides essential metrics for evaluating family planning initiatives. This resource was accessed on May 10, 2021. 5. The second edition of Safe Abortion: Technical and Policy Guidance for Health Systems offers comprehensive guidance on safe abortion practices and policies within health systems. 6. The WHO publication Programming Strategies for Postpartum Family Planning outlines strategies for implementing family planning services during the postpartum period. This document was accessed on May 10, 2021, and is available on the WHO reproductive health publications page. 7. A consensus definition of digital health was presented in the Digital Health and Interoperability presentation by the Key Terms and Theory of Change Small Working Group in 2019. The presentation, specifically slide 5, is accessible online, with the last access date being February 18, 2020. 8. The guide Developing Health Management Information Systems: A Practical Guide for Developing Countries provides practical advice for creating health management information systems in resource-limited settings. This document was accessed on October 8, 2020, via the WHO IRIS repository. 9. The International Classification of Diseases (ICD) Information Sheet provides an overview of the ICD system, which is used for disease classification. This resource was accessed on October 8, 2020, and is available on the WHO standards and classifications page. 10. The HL7 FHIR Release 4 website includes a section on data types, which provides detailed information on the data structures used in the FHIR standard. This resource was accessed on June 17, 2021.
